_readme: Copy this to profile.json and edit it. profile.json is gitignored.
Nothing here is sent anywhere. It is read locally to score postings.
name: Your Name
_years_note: Years of professional experience. Used to judge how far out of reach a posting's stated experience floor is. Count paid work, not study.
_home_note: Home is where going into an office is acceptable. Everything else is
remote-only. This is the rule the whole filter exists to express, and it
is why there is no list of acceptable countries anywhere in this project.
aliases:    strings that mean 'this job is at home'. Country, cities, and
any spelling variants including local diacritics.
covered_by: broader regions that include home. An aggregator listing
'Europe' covers someone in Portugal; one listing 'United
States' does not. Worldwide, anywhere and global are always
treated as covering you, so there is no need to add them.
_resume_note: Path to a markdown CV, relative to the project root. Read only to check which skills named in a job title you actually have. Optional: without it, stack matching is skipped and everything else still works.
